press.sentence: Updated SolidWorks: built Hub_m1.25_N17, inserted Hub as Hub_m1.25_N17-1 and mated it (Hub on Output Axis, Hub along Output and RangeSlv splined to Hub), gave RangeSlv its bands, changed 1 variable in Sleeve_m1.25_N17, moved RangeSlv in H to 55.5 mm and in N to 48 mm and in L to 40.5 mm along Output, re-placed Carrier (the carrier), Sun, Planet (3 copies), HighDog, LowDog, RangeSlv and Hub in every mode. Check: in N, Sprocket-4 and Hub interfere, 1408.381 mm³; RangeSlv and Sprocket-4 interfere, 374.463 mm³; in L, Sprocket-4 and Hub interfere, 1408.381 mm³; in H, Sprocket-4 and Hub interfere, 1408.381 mm³; RangeSlv and Sprocket-4 interfere, 160.748 mm³; look where they meet in RangeBox.SLDASM. It worked in H, the configuration that was active, then showed and checked N and L and left the assembly in H. Your Sprocket-1 went with Sun in every mode, which your locks hold it to. Your Sprocket-3 went with Sun in every mode, which your locks hold it to. Your Sprocket-2 went with RangeSlv in every mode, which your locks hold it to. Save Sleeve_m1.25_N17 and RangeBox in SolidWorks to keep them.
